section.catchline: Definition -- Assessment of property having a diminished productive value.
section.subsection: As used in this section, "diminished productive value" means that property has no, or a significantly reduced, ability to generate income as a result of:a parcel size requirement established under a land use ordinance or zoning map adopted by a:city or town in accordance with Title 10, Chapter 20, Part 5, Land Use Regulations - General Processes; ora county in accordance with Title 17, Chapter 79, Part 5, Land Use Regulations - General Processes; orone or more easements burdening the property.
In assessing the fair market value of property, a county assessor shall consider as part of the determination of fair market value whether property has diminished productive value.
This section does not prohibit a county assessor from including as part of a determination of the fair market value of property any other factor affecting the fair market value of the property.
